source.title: Forebears Mauritius forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables support representative Mauritian names. This is not an official civil registry export; gender grouping remains a review seed.

source.title: ITU Mauritius national numbering plan communication of 23.X.2025

phones.notes: ITU/ICTA confirms the migration of non-geographic mobile numbers to eight digits and a public 707X XXXX mobile allocation. The existing 5-leading mobile-style range is retained as a conservative review prefix; generated numbers are not portability-checked.

locations.notes: Mauritius Post confirms a public post-code finder by locality. District/city/street values are representative review samples; postalPrefixes are partial generator prefixes, not complete postcodes.

national_identity_card_number.label: National Identity Card Number

source.title: Mauritius National Identity Card Act text

national_identity_card_number.notes: The Act confirms the card records an NIC number. No current official public grammar, checksum or semantic digit logic was confirmed; NIC is a generator marker, not a claimed literal prefix.

passport.label: Passport
passport.notes: PRADO confirms Mauritius passport document families, but the public listing does not confirm passport-number grammar.
